notes.title: Build & Save
notes.content:
[h1]📦 [b]Release Notes 0.5[/b][/h1][h2]New Features[/h2][h3]Building System[/h3][p][b]Town Centre[/b][/p][list][*][p]Opens only when you click it (no longer auto-opens on interact).[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum of [b]1[/b] placeable.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mining Camp & Woodcutting Camp[/b][/p][list][*][p]Automatically gather [b]stone[/b] and [b]wood[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum of [b]3[/b] placeable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrades:[/b] increase collect range and unlock additional stone/wood types for auto-collect.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Houses[/b][/p][list][*][p]No functionality yet; will later affect the [b]unit cap[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]Controls & Options[/h3][list][*][p][b]Camera rotation[/b] added via the [b]arrow keys[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Options > Temporary “Camp Removal”[/b]: stuck/softlocked? Remove camps from the menu.
[i]Note:[/i] this applies [b]only[/b] to camps; [b]Town Centre[/b] and [b]Houses[/b] are not removed.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Audio & Music[/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]new main theme[/b] (soundtrack).[/p][/*][/list][h3]Saves[/h3][p]The new save layer now stores:[/p][list][*][p][b]Building positions[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Unit positions[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]UI revamp:[/b] cleaner look and clearer navigation.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Cross-selection:[/b] fixed an issue where the [b]selection box[/b] could remain stuck.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Known Issues & Workarounds[/h2][list][*][p][b]Audio slider + gamepad:[/b] with a gamepad connected, unintended input can push the [b]audio slider[/b] to the left.
[b]Workaround:[/b] temporarily [b]disconnect[/b] your controller. We’re monitoring frequency and working on a proper fix.[/p][/*][/list][p]Vragen aan ChatGPT[/p]

notes.title: Fixes & UI Polish
notes.content: [h2]📦 Release Notes 0.4[/h2][h3]✅ Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Floating trees[/b] have been grounded — no more unintended levitation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Characters no longer float[/b] above the ground.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bottom UI buttons[/b] no longer select multiple units at once.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Upgrade cost[/b] reduced for better game balance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resource progression bar[/b] added to show gathering progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Distant objects[/b] no longer turn black — improved visual consistency.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎨 UI / UX Updates[/h3][list][*][p][b]Action buttons now show unit status[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Idle[/b] – character is doing nothing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interacting[/b] – character is busy[/p][/*][*][p][b]Selected[/b] – currently selected unit/button[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]
